simple.summary: נָכָא (nâkâʼ) means to smite , i.e. drive away First listed occurrence: Job 30 8.

definitions.full: H5217. naka [ נָכָא ] verb smite, scourge (rare Aramaizing form of נָכָה ); — only Niph`al Perfect 3plural מִןהָֿאָרֶץ נִכְּאוּ Job 30:8 they are scourged out of the land .
